theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+4.26%) and Consumer Staples (+3.55%) led the market today, while Energy (-4.66%) and Industrials (-1.09%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +2.34%, defensives +2.43%, and value/cyclicals +0.75% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +3.05% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell +1.46%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.54%. The VIX fell 20.18% to 16.61, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 3.45% to $4,103.30, crude oil was little changed at $87.80, and bitcoin gained 0.46% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
